8.6 — Boss Revisions & Pre-Break Showcase

Last day before Winter Break! Yesterday your friends playtested your boss cold and handed you a list of real problems. Today you revise the top blockers, verify every fix on a fresh playtest run, freeze changes cleanly, and showcase your finished game before break.

In the Editor + Code: Revise & Re-Verify (~35 min) ~35 min

Work strictly top-down from your 8.5 playtest notes. A clean, complete boss fight beats an ambitious broken build every time:

  1. Fix Bugs & Soft-Locks first: any crash, missing "Ground" tag, stuck collider, or non-resetting hazard after StatManager.Die() gets fixed immediately.
  2. Fix Confusion second: clarify where to stand, how to hurt the boss (e.g., hit flash, Console/UI feedback, clear weak point), and how to exit/win once HP hits zero.
  3. Tune Numbers third: adjust health, speed, timeBetweenShots, or cooldownTimer only after bugs and confusion are solved.
  4. Verification Re-Test (mandatory!): ask one of yesterday's testers (or a new classmate) to replay ONLY to verify that your top revision actually solved the problem they ran into.
  5. Build Freeze & Smoke Check: press Play starting from Start (index 0) → Overworld → Platformer → Boss → Victory (plus one intentional death test). Commit and push cleanly with a clear commit message.

Socratic: Revising with Discipline

  1. Write down the specific complaint from yesterday's friend playtest, the exact change you made today (script line, prefab setting, or scene layout), and what happened when a tester re-played it.
  2. What feature or visual polish did you intentionally cut today so the core boss loop stays bug-free before break?
  3. If you tweak one more number ("just one quick buff to speed") five minutes before showcase WITHOUT re-playing the whole fight, what risk do you create?
Class Showcase: Play & Celebrate (~25 min) ~25 min

Walk around and play at least three classmates' boss builds. Notice how different everyone's boss feels even though every student started from the exact same Overworld & Cave starter!

Socratic: End-of-Year Reuse & Growth Retro

  1. Compare two bosses you played today: how did reusing the exact same components (EnemyController, TurretController, Platform, StatManager) produce totally different fights?
  2. Looking back from September's first movement line in 1.4 to today's full multi-scene RPG-to-Platformer boss game: which programming pattern (tags, state bools, cooldowns, singletons, events) ended up carrying the heaviest load?
  3. Carry one lesson forward into January's 3-Button Game Jam: next semester starts with zero starter boss and a strict three-input rule — what habit from brainstorming, prototyping, playtesting, and revising will you repeat on Day 1?

Checkpoint — before leaving for Winter Break:

  • Resolve the top confusion, bug, and balance notes from your 8.5 friend playtest
  • Re-verify your revisions cleanly in a full run from Start (index 0) through Victory and Death
  • Play and appreciate at least three classmates' finished boss builds
  • Commit and push your final pre-break build cleanly to GitHub
